title: Concept: Third-party tracking pixel on a banking page
description: A one-pixel image served from a third-party analytics host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The pixel reports which page the customer opened, along with the referrer, so the analytics vendor learns which product a named session looked at.
applicability: Deployments that render a one-pixel image served from a third-party analytics host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The pixel reports which page the customer opened, along with the referrer, so the analytics vendor learns which product a named session looked at.
